newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Gilts looking toppy, 110-10 to cap upside.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Gilts looking toppy, 110-10 to cap upside.

text.p: Any further gains in British gilts will be limited on Friday with the June contract soon bumping into resistance around 110-10 to 110-16, technical analysts said.
The contract may retrace back to 109-29 initially and then 109-18 before heading higher again.
"Gilts are looking pretty topish here," said Christian Bado, senior technical analyst at Ferrier Lullin in Geneva. "A top should take place at 110-16 -- from there I would sell."
June gilts opened down 4/32 at 110-01 before dipping to an early low of 109-31.
Bado said once the market retraced back to 109-18 it would likely bounce, targetting 111-18 in the medium term.
Analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell were more optimistic on gilts near term but said the contract could move lower medium term.
They said daily stochastics remained supportive and upticks in the June contract could extend to 110-28, 111-00, the 50 percent retracement of the February declines.
"This area is expected to provide a ceiling," they said.
DMG said immediate support came in at 109-29, ahead of the 109-16 inverse head and shoulders neckline.
"A break of the latter would signal that the upside retracement is complete and trigger a resumption of the overall move lower," said DMG.
A retreat through 109-16 would put 108-20 trendline support to the test, they said.
"The latter marks the trigger for 108-05 initially, ahead of more medium term declines to the 107-24 area, then the 106-08 region longer term," they said.
In early trade short sterling was down across the strip. By 0739 GMT the June contract was down two basis points at 93.44 and September was down three basis points at 93.17.
